title: A binary counter

milestone.title: Binary: The Language of the Machine

description:
Count from 0 to 15 in binary and watch the bits change.

```
 0  0000
 1  0001
 2  0010
 3  0011
...
15  1111
```
hints: Every bit changes when `n ^ (n - 1)` is `0b1111`; or compare the two strings character by character.
requirements: Print every number with 4 bits, padded with zeros.
Mark with `*` the lines where every bit changes from the line before (like 7 to 8).
Do it once with `format(n, "04b")` and once by working out each bit with `//` and `%`.
stretch: Count up to 255 with 8 bits and print how many 1s each number has.
